kb_articles.title: Optimizing Minecraft Servers with Aikar Flags & Purpur
kb_articles.excerpt: Step-by-step guide to garbage collection JVM tuning, view-distance optimization, and entity ticking config.
kb_articles.content:
### High-Performance Minecraft Configuration

When running a Minecraft server on LumaCloud, default Java garbage collection can cause sporadic tick skips and stuttering.

#### Recommended Java Startup Flags (Aikar Flags):
```bash
java -Xms4G -Xmx4G -XX:+UseG1GC -XX:+ParallelRefProcEnabled -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=200 -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+DisableExplicitGC -XX:+AlwaysPreTouch -XX:G1NewSizePercent=30 -XX:G1MaxNewSizePercent=40 -XX:G1ReservePercent=20 -XX:G1HeapWastePercent=5 -XX:G1MixedGCCountTarget=4 -XX:InitiatingHeapOccupancyPercent=15 -XX:G1MixedGCLiveThresholdPercent=90 -XX:G1RSetUpdatingPauseTimePercent=5 -XX:SurvivorRatio=32 -XX:+PerfDisableSharedMem -XX:MaxTenuringThreshold=1 -jar server.jar nogui
```

#### Recommended Server Config Adjustments:
1. In `server.properties`, set `view-distance=6` or `simulation-distance=4`.
2. In `purpur.yml`, disable aggressive entity brain ticking for inactive mobs.
3. Install **Spark** profiler plugin to trace lag sources.

kb_articles.title: VPS Initial Setup: SSH Keys, Firewall & Fail2ban
kb_articles.excerpt: Harden your Debian/Ubuntu cloud server against brute force attacks in under 5 minutes.
kb_articles.content:
### Securing Your LumaCloud VPS

Every new cloud server should be secured immediately upon deployment.

#### 1. Generate SSH Key Pair (Local Computer)
```bash
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "your_email@example.com"
ssh-copy-id root@YOUR_SERVER_IP
```

#### 2. Disable Password Authentication
Edit `/etc/ssh/sshd_config`:
```ini
PasswordAuthentication no
PermitRootLogin prohibit-password
```
Restart SSH daemon:
```bash
systemctl restart sshd
```

#### 3. Enable UFW Firewall
```bash
ufw default deny incoming
ufw default allow outgoing
ufw allow 22/tcp
ufw allow 80/tcp
ufw allow 443/tcp
ufw enable
```

kb_articles.title: Pterodactyl Panel Game Server File Management & SFTP
kb_articles.excerpt: How to upload large modpacks, server worlds, and plugins using secure SFTP clients like Cyberduck or FileZilla.
kb_articles.content:
### Using SFTP with LumaCloud Game Panel

Web uploads in browser are limited to 100MB per file. For world folders and large modpacks, connect directly with SFTP.

#### Connection Details:
- **Host**: Look at the Settings tab in your server console (e.g. `node1.lumacloud.xyz:2022`).
- **Username**: Your panel username followed by a period and server ID (e.g. `user.7c18a9`).
- **Password**: Your main LumaCloud client area account password.

kb_articles.title: LumaCloud DDoS Mitigation Architecture & DNS Configuration
kb_articles.excerpt: Understand how our multi-terabit Anycast BGP filtering protects your game and web ports.
kb_articles.content:
### Automatic Layer 3/4 and Layer 7 Filtering

All LumaCloud IP ranges are protected by always-on Anycast scrubbing centers with over 3.2 Tbps aggregate mitigation capacity.

#### Protection Characteristics:
- Sub-second detection of UDP reflection floods (NTP, DNS, Memcached).
- SYN-cookie proxies for TCP services (Minecraft, web).
- No additional configuration needed on the client side.
